title: Venturi Tube

introduction.definition: A venturi tube measures flow with a smooth convergent cone, a short throat and a long divergent cone. Velocity rises and pressure falls in the throat (Bernoulli); the gentle diffuser recovers most of that pressure, so the permanent loss is only about 5–20 % of the measured ΔP — the lowest of the DP meters. It also tolerates dirty liquids (ISO 5167-4).
key_points: Lowest permanent loss of DP meters
Piezometer rings average pressure around the circumference
introduction.summary: A venturi tube measures flow with a smooth convergent cone, a short cylindrical throat and a gentle divergent cone. Pressure falls in the throat as velocity rises (Bernoulli), and the long diffuser recovers most of it, so permanent pressure loss is very low — ideal for large water mains and energy-sensitive services. It also tolerates dirty fluids better than an orifice (ISO 5167-4).

video_tutorials.title: Venturi Tube — Introduction

script.narration: This module introduces the Venturi Tube.
A venturi tube measures flow with a smooth convergent cone, a short throat and a long divergent cone.

Velocity rises and pressure falls in the throat (Bernoulli); the gentle diffuser recovers most of that pressure, so the permanent loss is only about 5–20 % of the measured ΔP — the lowest of the DP meters.
It also tolerates dirty liquids (ISO 5167-4).
Typical applications include large water and wastewater mains; cooling-water and raw-water intakes; slurry and dirty liquids; energy-sensitive pumping systems.
The cutaway reveals the internal construction.
The exploded view separates every component so each one can be tapped for its function, material and failure modes.
Next, watch the operation tutorial to see how it works.

script.narration: How the Venturi Tube works.
Flow enters the inlet cylinder (upstream tap).
The convergent cone accelerates the flow; pressure falls.
In the throat velocity is highest and pressure lowest (throat tap).
The divergent cone slows the flow and recovers most of the pressure.
The flow overlay traces the liquid from suction to discharge.
In the convergent cone velocity rises and static pressure falls (Bernoulli), reaching a minimum in the throat.

video_tutorials.title: Venturi Tube — Maintenance

script.narration: Maintenance essentials for the Venturi Tube.
Check zero and impulse lines.
Flush piezometer rings and taps.
Inspect throat for deposits.
Watch for blocked taps: flat or erratic reading. Common cause: solids in taps.
Watch for deposits in throat: over-reading. Common cause: scaling.
Record every inspection so trends — vibration, temperature, leakage and performance — can be compared over time.
